name: Watashi no Hero Academia
source:
We follow the story of a high school female student, who takes part in one of the best Japanese academy for superheroes: the UA (class 1-A).
One day as any other, when she checks her phone, she sees a new text from... one of her classmates?

Choose a name for the protagonist and follow a love story between her and one of three heroes (Midoriya Izuku, Bakugou Katsuki or Todoroki Shouto) in this fan retelling of Boku no Hero Academia.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://fantome-traducciones.blogspot.com/2020/12/parche-espanoldescarga-watashi-no-hero.html]Fantome Traducciones[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕一名高中女生展开。她就读于日本最优秀的超级英雄学校之一，雄英高中1年A班。
某个平凡的日子，她查看手机，却看见一条新消息，来自……班上的某位同学？

为主角取个名字，在这部重新演绎《我的英雄学院》的同人作品中，体验她与绿谷出久、爆豪胜己或轰焦冻，其中一位英雄之间的恋爱故事。

[译编自[url=https://fantome-traducciones.blogspot.com/2020/12/parche-espanoldescarga-watashi-no-hero.html]Fantome Traducciones[/url]]
